about.body: The S68 is BMW M's twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 petrol engine, used in Land Rover applications from 2024. It's the highest-performance combustion engine in the current Land Rover range, fitted to the Defender Octa, Range Rover SV and Range Rover Sport SV. The S68 is a BMW M-sourced engine — the same engine family that powers BMW's own M performance models — and it's the first time this specific engine has appeared in Land Rover's portfolio.

byModel.body: Across the Defender, the S68 powers the Octa (L663, 2024–present) — the most powerful production Defender ever made, producing up to 635 hp. The Range Rover uses the S68 in the SV (L460, 2024–present), a high-performance luxury SUV variant. The Range Rover Sport follows the same pattern with the SV (L461, 2024–present), offering the same S68 powerplant in a sportier body shell. All three applications use the S68 with 48V mild-hybrid assistance.

compatibility.body: The S68 is a BMW M engine — not a JLR-designed engine. Compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and generation, which we do by registration. All three Land Rover applications (Defender Octa, Range Rover SV, Range Rover Sport SV) use the same base S68 engine, but specific ancillaries and tuning vary by application. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle and variant.
